item.title: Feather mites in horses is a challenging problem for owners to tackle – here’s what you need to know
item.description: Feather mites in horses are among the most stubborn of equine parasites, causing a condition commonly called heel mange (chorioptic mange). The condition typically affects heavily feathered breeds such as traditional cobs, Shires, Clydesdales and Friesians, and some native ponies. When severely affected, horses with an infestation will typically stamp their hooves, and bite or […]
